input_contract: queries,catalog: integer coordinate ticks in +/-1000000000; strictly increasing squared_edges[2..65] in0..12000000000000000000; coordinate_unit required

result_contract: N*B x u32 shell counts, lower inclusive/upper exclusive; catalog groups not implicitly deduplicated
precision_requirements: Exact bounded integer arithmetic. 64-bit values are serialized as low/high uint32 words. Float inputs rejected; no implicit quantization.
validation_method: Entire output byte stream vs independent Python arbitrary-precision CPU reference; edge vectors before search; each timing candidate checked before/after; held-out winner confirmation.

partition_strategy: query rows/bins; sum per-query counts to obtain cross-group shell totals
